name: Student Visa / Resident Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Acceptance letter from a Jamaican educational institution, valid passport (6+ months), proof of sufficient funds, sponsor information, return ticket -- applied for via a Jamaican Embassy/Consulate.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initial landing if institutional arrangements are pre-established; 2 months (extendable to 1 year) if not yet arranged

sources.title: Jamaica Tertiary Education Commission (J-TEC), a statutory government education agency -- Student Visa/Resident Permit: acceptance letter, valid passport, proof of funds, sponsor info, return ticket; 1-year initial landing if institutional arrangements pre-established, 2 months (extendable to 1 year) otherwise; students over 16 must register as aliens with PICA or rural parish police stations

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: DRAFT -- the source is tier-1 (J-TEC, a statutory government agency) but does not specify whether or how much students may work during study -- work_rights set to 'none' as a conservative default, not a confirmed prohibition. Kept draft on completeness grounds despite the tier-1 source. Students over 16 must separately register as aliens with PICA -- disclosed as a procedural step, not modeled as its own requirement.
